svg.aria-label: Every coupler on the water run, clean jug to faucet
svg.text: its own strainer on the inlet,
its own 1/2 in barbs, screwed in
in left, out up and right
screws up into each hose nut
Water: clean jug → pump → reducer → tee → two adapters → the faucet's two hoses
A · every barb joint (9 of them)
1 Slide the clamp onto the tube first.
2 Dip the tube end in hot water for 30 s.
3 Push it on past the last ridge, wiggling.
4 Clamp over the ridges, screw snug. Not on bare tube.
B · adapter into a faucet hose (2 of them)
hose nut, washer inside: it seals
1 Three wraps of PTFE tape, clockwise looking at the thread end.
2 Thread the adapter up into the hose nut by hand.
3 Then about 1/4 turn with a wrench. Tape and washer seal it; don't crank.
The 5/8 in OD tube pushes straight
through the 5/8 in holes in the cap,
snug. To take the jug out, lift the
fill tube and unscrew the cap: the
Clamps: SAE 6, fit both tube sizes. 9 used, 1 spare.
Tubing: 1/2 in to the reducer, 3/8 in after it.
